name: What is the typical timeline for completing a side-house addition project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for completing a side-house addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a side-house addition generally spans several months, typically from 6 to 12 months, depending on the project's scale and local permitting processes. This includes design, architectural plans, securing permits, foundation work, framing, roofing, utility hook-ups, and interior finishes. Larger or more intricate designs, along with potential unforeseen site conditions, can extend the duration. We work to provide a detailed project schedule upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: A side-house addition typically takes 6 to 12 months, encompassing design, permitting, construction, and finishing work. The exact timeline depends on project scope and permit approvals.
